intro: The Tree of Life is a map of the descent of spirit into matter and of the soul's return. Each sefirah (emanation) carries a planetary intelligence; each path between two sefirot carries a Hebrew letter, a Tarot key and an astrological sign, planet or element. Laying a natal chart over the Tree shows which powers the incarnation leans on and which roads between them are open.
activity: A sefirah is lit according to the strength of its planet in the chart: one point per major aspect, two for an angular house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th), two for the planet in its own sign, two for a conjunction with the Ascendant or Midheaven, and one for each aspect pattern it belongs to. A zodiac path is lit when a body occupies its sign; a planetary path is lit when that planet is strong (angular, dignified or on an angle); an element path is lit when that element dominates the chart. Aspects between the planets of two sefirot are drawn as links in the aspect colours.

kether.name: Kether
kether.title: The Crown
kether.astrological: Primum Mobile — the first swirlings, the zodiac as a whole; Neptune (or Pluto) in modern esoteric frameworks
kether.divineName: Eheieh (I Am / I Am That I Am)
kether.archangel: Metatron, Prince of the Divine Presence
kether.order: Chaioth ha-Qadesh, the Holy Living Creatures
kether.experience: Union with the Divine; pure undifferentiated light
kether.virtue: Attainment, completion of the Great Work
kether.meaning: The point of origin, the will-to-be before it has become anything. Kether is the source that cannot be seen because it is what sees.
kether.astrologicalMeaning: The spark of incarnation, the soul's highest purpose and the evolutionary impulse entering the birth chart. With Neptune as its planet, Kether shows where the boundary between self and source is thinnest and where the life is called to serve something larger than the personality.

chokmah.name: Chokmah
chokmah.title: Wisdom
chokmah.astrological: The Zodiac / the sphere of the fixed stars; Uranus in modern attribution
chokmah.experience: The vision of God face to face
chokmah.meaning: The first outpouring of force, the great father, pure dynamic energy without form: the flash of insight before it is put into words.
chokmah.astrologicalMeaning: The lightning of awakening in the chart. Uranus in Chokmah shows where the native breaks with inherited patterns and receives sudden, impersonal knowing; a strong Chokmah is a life organised around originality and liberation.

binah.name: Binah
binah.title: Understanding
binah.meaning: The great mother, the womb that gives form to the force of Chokmah by limiting it. Binah understands by containing; she is the sea from which all forms are born and to which they return.
binah.astrologicalMeaning: Saturn's place in the chart shows where the soul accepts limitation in order to build something real. Binah is the discipline, the patience and the sorrow of taking form; a strong Binah is a life that matures into authority through endurance.

daat.name: Da'at
daat.title: Knowledge
daat.astrological: Pluto (modern attribution); the abyss between the supernal triad and the seven below
daat.divineName: YHVH Elohim (through Binah) — Da'at has no name of its own
daat.archangel: None assigned; the Archangels of the four directions guard the crossing
daat.meaning: The hidden sefirah, the knowledge that is the child of Wisdom and Understanding. Da'at is not a sphere but a gate: the place where the supernal is known in the created and the self must die to cross.
daat.astrologicalMeaning: Pluto in the chart shows where the personality is stripped and regenerated, the hidden knowledge that comes through crisis. A strong Da'at marks a life with a passage through the underworld built into it.

chesed.name: Chesed
chesed.title: Mercy
chesed.meaning: The loving king who builds and gives, the architect who lays down the order of the world in abundance. Chesed is expansion, generosity and the memory of the source in the created world.
chesed.astrologicalMeaning: Jupiter's sign and house show where the native grows, trusts and is blessed, and where they are meant to give. A strong Chesed is a vocation of teaching, provision or benevolent leadership.

geburah.name: Geburah
geburah.title: Severity, Strength
geburah.meaning: The warrior and the surgeon, the power that removes what is unbalanced so that Chesed's building does not become bloat. Geburah is judgement, discipline and the courage to cut.
geburah.astrologicalMeaning: Mars shows where the native fights, asserts and clears the ground. A strong Geburah is a life that must learn the right use of force: to defend, to decide and to burn away what no longer serves.

tiphareth.name: Tiphareth
tiphareth.title: Beauty
tiphareth.experience: The vision of the harmony of things; the mysteries of sacrifice
tiphareth.meaning: The heart of the Tree, the child and the sacrificed king, where the light above is balanced with the life below. Tiphareth is the true self, the sun at the centre of the personal system.
tiphareth.astrologicalMeaning: The Sun's sign, house and aspects describe the identity the soul has chosen to shine through. A strong Tiphareth is a life whose purpose is visible and central, the person who becomes an integrating centre for others.

netzach.name: Netzach
netzach.title: Victory, Eternity
netzach.meaning: The sphere of desire, instinct, art and the emotions, nature's endless victory of life over form. Netzach is the feeling that draws things together.
netzach.astrologicalMeaning: Venus shows what the native loves and values and how they attract. A strong Netzach is a purpose expressed through beauty, relationship and the arts, and a lesson in loving without possessing.

hod.name: Hod
hod.title: Splendour, Glory
hod.order: Beni Elohim, the Sons of God
hod.meaning: The sphere of the mind, language, magic and science; the forms that thought gives to the feelings of Netzach. Hod is the shaper of symbols.
hod.astrologicalMeaning: Mercury shows how the native thinks, speaks and learns. A strong Hod is a purpose worked out through communication, analysis and the craft of naming things truly.

yesod.name: Yesod
yesod.title: Foundation
yesod.experience: The vision of the machinery of the universe
yesod.meaning: The astral foundation on which the physical world rests: dreams, images, the unconscious, the tides and the sexual current of life. Yesod is the treasure-house of images.
yesod.astrologicalMeaning: The Moon shows the emotional body, instinct, memory and the inheritance from the past that the soul carries into this life. A strong Yesod is a purpose rooted in imagination, nurture and the unseen currents between people.

malkuth.name: Malkuth
malkuth.title: The Kingdom
malkuth.astrological: The Earth; the Ascendant as the point of incarnation, the sphere of the elements
malkuth.experience: The vision of the Holy Guardian Angel
malkuth.meaning: The Kingdom, the body and the world, the end of the descent and the beginning of the return. Malkuth is the bride, the gate, and the place where all the powers above are finally tested.
malkuth.astrologicalMeaning: The Ascendant and the 1st house show the body and the circumstances the soul has taken on: the vehicle for the whole Tree. A strong Malkuth is a life whose purpose is grounded in the physical, in the earth and in what can actually be built.

0.name: The Fool
0.purpose: A life that must be lived by stepping off the edge; purpose is found by trusting the unknown rather than by planning it.

1.name: The Magician
1.purpose: A life about directing will through skill; purpose is realised by becoming a clear channel between idea and form.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.purpose: A life guarded by the veil; purpose is served by listening inward and holding what cannot yet be spoken.

3.name: The Empress
3.purpose: A life that grows things; purpose is expressed through creating, nourishing and making the world more alive.

4.name: The Emperor
4.purpose: A life of building order; purpose is realised through responsibility, boundaries and the mastery of a domain.

5.name: The Hierophant
5.purpose: A life of transmitting meaning; purpose is served by learning a lineage deeply and passing it on.

6.name: The Lovers
6.purpose: A life shaped by choice and relationship; purpose is discovered through the mirror of the other.

7.name: The Chariot
7.purpose: A life of directed will; purpose is realised by harnessing opposing forces and driving toward a goal.

8.name: Strength
8.purpose: A life of taming the inner beast with love rather than force; purpose is quiet courage.

9.name: The Hermit
9.purpose: A life of seeking and guiding; purpose is found in solitude and shared by holding up the lamp for others.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.purpose: A life of turning points; purpose is learned by riding the cycles rather than resisting them.

11.name: Justice
11.purpose: A life of weighing and restoring balance; purpose is served through fairness, clarity and accountability.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.purpose: A life that must see things upside down; purpose is realised through surrender and the gift found in waiting.

13.name: Death
13.purpose: A life of transformations; purpose is served by ending what is finished so that what is new can be born.

14.name: Temperance
14.purpose: A life of blending opposites; purpose is realised through patience, healing and the art of the middle way.

15.name: The Devil
15.purpose: A life of meeting the shadow and the material; purpose is found by freeing oneself from what binds and laughing at it.

16.name: The Tower
16.purpose: A life of sudden clearings; purpose is served by letting false structures fall so that truth can stand.

17.name: The Star
17.purpose: A life that pours itself out for others; purpose is realised through hope, healing and inspiration.

18.name: The Moon
18.purpose: A life walked by moonlight; purpose is found by trusting intuition through the unclear passages.

19.name: The Sun
19.purpose: A life meant to shine; purpose is realised through warmth, clarity and the courage to be seen.

20.name: Judgement
20.purpose: A life answering a call; purpose is served by rising to what summons you and helping others rise.

21.name: The World
21.purpose: A life of completing cycles; purpose is realised by integrating the whole and dancing within its limits.

birthCards: Tarot birth cards (after Mary K. Greer): add the month, day and full year as numbers; if the sum is above 22 add its digits. The result is the Personality card; adding its digits again gives the Soul card (the same card when the number is below 10). A result of 19 yields the trio 19/10/1, a result of 22 is the Fool (0). The cards' paths are marked on the Tree.
numerologyMap: Numerology numbers map to the sefirot by count: 1 Kether, 2 Chokmah, 3 Binah, 4 Chesed, 5 Geburah, 6 Tiphareth, 7 Netzach, 8 Hod, 9 Yesod, 11 Da'at (the hidden gate), 22 Chokmah at its highest, 33 Binah at its highest. The Life Path is marked with a ring, the Expression with a dot.
